description: This file defines the TextValue class, which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library for handling conditional formatting rules involving text patterns, such as 'contains', 'starts with', or 'ends with'. It provides methods for configuring such rules and generating corresponding expressions.

classes.name: TextValue
classes.description: A class that facilitates creating and managing conditional formatting rules based on text content, with operations like 'contains', 'begins with', 'ends with', including conversion from Conditional objects. Extends WizardAbstract and implements WizardInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TextValue object with a specified cell range.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Sets the operator for the text condition, such as 'contains' or 'beginsWith'.

methods.name: operand
methods.description: Sets the operand value for the condition and its value type.

methods.name: wrapValue
methods.description: Wraps a string value in quotes for expression formation.

methods.name: setExpression
methods.description: Generates the conditional expression string based on current operator and operand.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Creates and returns a Conditional object configured with the current rule settings.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates a TextValue wizard instance from an existing Conditional object, analyzing its condition type and text.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method allowing calling operations like contains, beginsWith, etc., dynamically setting the operator and operand.
